from math import pi
import math
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close, test_fail
from explRL.params import Params

N = 32
p = Params()
th = grid(N)
reb = rEB(5, N, p.kappaEB)
test_close(reb.min(), 0.0)
test_close(reb.max(), 1.0)
test_close(reb[5], 1.0)
test_close(fbNorm(32), 12.0)

wG = sinGoal(0.5, th[8], N)
gs = goalStats(wG)
test_close(gs['thetaG'], th[8], eps=1e-9)
test_close(gs['rG'], 0.5 * N / 2, eps=1e-9)
test_fail(lambda: sinGoal(0.6, 0.0, N), contains='g must')
test_fail(lambda: sinGoal(-0.1, 0.0, N), contains='g must')

# AC-2 closed form
D = fbNorm(N)
rG = gs['rG']
thetaG = gs['thetaG']
for c in range(N):
    out = outputs(wG, c, p)
    tc = th[c]
    dS_cf = 0.5 + rG / (2 * D) * np.sin(tc - thetaG)
    test_close(out['dS'], dS_cf, eps=1e-9)
ds_all = np.array([outputs(wG, c, p)['dS'] for c in range(N)])
test_eq(int(ds_all.argmax()), 16)
test_close(ds_all.min(), 1/6, eps=1e-9)
test_close(ds_all.max(), 5/6, eps=1e-9)
nu_all = np.array([outputs(wG, c, p)['nuF'] for c in range(N)])
test_eq(int(nu_all.argmin()), 8)

# section 10 table spot checks
for g, rG_exp in [(0.25, 4.0), (0.5, 8.0)]:
    w = sinGoal(g, 0.0, N)
    test_close(goalStats(w)['rG'], rG_exp, eps=1e-6)
w1 = np.ones(N)
test_close(goalStats(w1)['strength'], 0.0, eps=1e-9)
test_close(outputs(w1, 0, p)['rF'], -0.233, eps=1e-3)

# ring activity
act_a = ringActivity(0, N, False)
test_eq(int((act_a > 0).sum()), 3)
test_close(act_a[[0, 1, N-1]].tolist(), [1.0, 0.5, 0.5])
act_w = ringActivity(N - 1, N, False)
test_close(act_w[[N - 1, 0, N - 2]].tolist(), [1.0, 0.5, 0.5])
act_s = ringActivity(0, N, True)
test_eq(int((act_s > 0).sum()), 6)
wC0 = np.ones((N, N)) * 0.5
test_close(jumpProb(wC0, act_a, 0), 0.5)
test_close(jumpProb(np.zeros((N, N)), act_a, 0), 0.5)

# AC-4 goal plasticity
wG0 = sinGoal(0.3, th[0], N).copy()
c_fix = 8

def _ang_to_c(gs, c):
    return abs((gs['thetaG'] - th[c] + pi) % (2 * pi) - pi)

w_r = goalStep(wG0, c_fix, 1, p)
w_p = goalStep(wG0, c_fix, -1, p)
w_z = goalStep(wG0, c_fix, 0, p)
test_close(w_z, wG0)
assert _ang_to_c(goalStats(w_r), c_fix) < _ang_to_c(goalStats(wG0), c_fix)
assert _ang_to_c(goalStats(w_p), c_fix) > _ang_to_c(goalStats(wG0), c_fix)
assert goalStats(goalStep(wG0, 0, 1, p))['strength'] > goalStats(wG0)['strength']
assert w_r.min() >= 0 and w_r.max() <= 1

# AC-5 compass plasticity
from explRL.envs import ZoneArena
rng = np.random.default_rng(0)
wC = rng.uniform(0, 1, (N, N))
env = ZoneArena(N=N, symmetric=False)
mirror = 10
def mean_pj(wC):
    return float(np.mean([jumpProb(wC, env.ringActivity(a), (mirror - a) % N) for a in range(N)]))
p0 = mean_pj(wC)
for _ in range(1000):
    direction = 1 if rng.random() < 0.5 else -1
    size = float(np.deg2rad(rng.lognormal(p.muS, p.sigmaS)))
    steps = max(1, int(math.ceil(size / (2 * pi / N))))
    a = int(rng.integers(N))
    c = (mirror - a) % N
    for _ in range(steps):
        wC = compassStep(wC, env.ringActivity(a), c, size, p)
        a = (a + direction) % N
        c = (c - direction) % N
assert p0 > 0.45
assert mean_pj(wC) < 0.15
assert wC.min() >= 0 and wC.max() <= 1

for w0 in (np.zeros((N, N)), np.ones((N, N))):
    w1 = compassStep(w0, ringActivity(3, N, False), 3, 0.1, p)
    assert w1.min() >= 0 and w1.max() <= 1
    w2 = goalStep(np.zeros(N), 4, 1, p)
    assert w2.min() >= 0 and w2.max() <= 1

text:
Summary
With Table 1 circuit parameters, the decided answers to spec Q1-Q12 and no tuning, 20 model flies per set-up (seeds 0-19) gave:

AC-8 (Fig 3i, perfect compass, 1200 s): the goal’s distance to the nearest safe-zone center fell from 45.2 degrees at the start to 11.0 degrees (time average over the last quarter); goal strength rose from 0.39 to 0.82.
AC-9 (Fig 4): after 2400 s in the asymmetric scene, the mean jump probability along the learned map is 0.057 and a frozen probe jumps after 8.8% of saccades (50% with random weights). After 4800 s in the symmetric scene, the probe still jumps after 41.8% of saccades.
AC-10 (Fig 5): goals started at a danger center (90 degrees from safe) and ended 10.9 degrees from safe after 1200 s; the mean probe PI rose from -0.23 to 0.24. Single flies end between -0.20 and 0.64 (reported, not asserted). The goal ends on average 28 degrees from the most stable compass heading.

The full run takes about 21 s.

from math import pi
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_fail, test_close
from explRL.params import Params

p = Params()
g = pi
ths = np.linspace(0, 2 * pi, 37, endpoint=False)
dS = turnProb(ths, g, p)
nu = driftRate(ths, g, p)
pj = jumpProb(ths, g, p)
assert dS.min() >= 0.05 and dS.max() <= 0.95
assert nu.min() >= 0.05 and nu.max() <= 0.85 + 1e-9
assert pj.min() >= 0.05 and pj.max() <= 0.75
for i, th in enumerate(ths):
    test_close(turnProb(th, g, p), dS[i]); test_close(jumpProb(th, g, p), pj[i])

def theta_at_rel_deg(rel_deg, goal=pi):
    return wrap(goal + np.deg2rad(rel_deg))

eff = effectivePolicy(np.array([theta_at_rel_deg(r) for r in (0, 90, -90, 180)]), g, p)
fd0, fd90, fd180 = eff['fixDur'][0], eff['fixDur'][1], eff['fixDur'][3]
assert fd0 > fd90 and fd180 > fd90
for rel in (30, -30, 80, -80):
    tb = effectivePolicy(theta_at_rel_deg(rel), g, p)['turnBias']
    assert np.sign(tb) == -np.sign(rel)
for rel in (150, -150, 170, -170):
    tb = effectivePolicy(theta_at_rel_deg(rel), g, p)['turnBias']
    assert np.sign(tb) == np.sign(rel)

test_close(eff0['nu'], driftRate(th, g, p0))
test_close(eff0['fixDur'], p0.aF / eff0['nu'])
assert eff0['fixDur'].argmax() == int(np.argmin(np.abs(angdiff(th, g))))

def toy_prestructured(theta=-0.1, seed=0, thetaC=None, **kw):
    pol = prestructuredPolicy(pi)
    params = Params(**kw)
    return prestructuredAgent(theta, pi, pol, GoalHeadingRL(pol, lr=0.0), params,
                              rng=np.random.default_rng(seed), thetaC=thetaC)

a = toy_prestructured()
test_close(a.theta, 2 * pi - 0.1)
test_close(a.thetaC, a.theta)
test_fail(lambda: prestructuredAgent(0.0, pi, Policy(), GoalHeadingRL(prestructuredPolicy(pi)), Params()),
          contains='prestructuredPolicy')
ev = toy_prestructured(seed=4).samplePolicy()
assert ev.fixDur > 0
assert abs(ev.dx) > 0 and abs(ev.dx) != round(abs(ev.dx))
off = abs(angdiff(ev.thetaC_next, wrap(ev.thetaC + ev.dx)))
test_close(off, 0.0 if not ev.jumped else pi)
a0, a1 = toy_prestructured(seed=5), toy_prestructured(seed=5)
for _ in range(20):
    test_eq(a0.samplePolicy(), a1.samplePolicy())

Mean fixation duration at the anti-goal compass heading (heavy-tailed at the goal):

ag = toy_prestructured(thetaC=0.0, seed=99)
ag.policy.thetaG = pi
nu_ag = float(driftRate(ag.thetaC, ag.policy.thetaG, ag.params))
pred = ag.params.aF / nu_ag
durs = [ag.samplePolicy().fixDur for _ in range(20000)]
test_close(np.mean(durs), pred, eps=0.05 * pred)

AC-6: Observed CW and jump rates match predictions (20 000 calls):

ag = toy_prestructured(thetaC=1.0, seed=7)
ag.policy.thetaG = 2.0
dS_pred = float(turnProb(ag.thetaC, ag.policy.thetaG, ag.params))
cw, jumped, post_c = [], [], []
for _ in range(20000):
    ev = ag.samplePolicy()
    cw.append(ev.direction > 0)
    jumped.append(ev.jumped)
    post_c.append(wrap(ag.thetaC + ev.dx))
test_close(np.mean(cw), dS_pred, eps=0.01)
pj_pred = float(np.mean([jumpProb(c1, ag.policy.thetaG, ag.params) for c1 in post_c]))
test_close(np.mean(jumped), pj_pred, eps=0.01)

def fd_logPiS(rl, agent, ev, h=1e-6):
    g0 = rl.policy.thetaG
    g = lambda x: rl.logPiS(agent, ev, thetaG=x)
    return (g(g0 + h) - g(g0 - h)) / (2 * h)

rl = GoalHeadingRL(prestructuredPolicy(0.0))
agent = toy_prestructured(thetaC=0.5, seed=1)
agent.policy = rl.policy
agent.rl = rl
for d in (1, -1):

        ev = Event(agent.theta, tc, 0.1, d, 0.05 * d, False, wrap(tc + 0.05 * d))
        test_close(rl.gradLogPiS(agent, ev), fd_logPiS(rl, agent, ev), eps=1e-6)

def dS_at(agent, tc=None):
    tc = agent.thetaC if tc is None else tc
    return float(turnProb(tc, agent.policy.thetaG, agent.params))

rl = GoalHeadingRL(prestructuredPolicy(pi), lr=0.01)
agent = toy_prestructured(seed=2)
agent.policy = rl.policy
agent.rl = rl
ev = Event(agent.theta, agent.thetaC, 0.1, 1, 0.02, False, wrap(agent.thetaC + 0.02))
before = dS_at(agent)
rl.updateParams(agent, ev, 1.0)
assert dS_at(agent) > before
rl.policy.thetaG = pi
before = dS_at(agent)
rl.updateParams(agent, ev, -1.0)
assert dS_at(agent) < before
g_fixed = rl.policy.thetaG
rl.lr = 0.0
rl.updateParams(agent, ev, 1.0)
test_close(rl.policy.thetaG, g_fixed)
assert np.isfinite(rl.policy.thetaG)

def runManyPrestructured(
    params, goal, nRuns, seed:int=0, Ttot:NoneType=None, learn:bool=True, thetaG0:NoneType=None

Training loop timing and arrays:

from math import pi
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close
from explRL.core import loadPrestructuredAgent, loadEnv
from explRL.params import Params

p = Params()
agent = loadPrestructuredAgent(params=p, goal=pi, seed=0, learn=False, thetaG0=pi)
env = loadEnv(goal=pi)
hist = train_prestructured(agent, env, Ttot=5.0)
n = len(hist.t)
assert n > 0
for arr in (hist.thetaA, hist.thetaC, hist.fixDur, hist.direction, hist.jumped, hist.reward, hist.thetaG):
    test_eq(len(arr), n)
assert float(hist.t[-1]) < 5.0
assert float(hist.t[-1] + hist.fixDur[-1] + p.tS) >= 5.0
test_close(hist.thetaG, pi)

AC-7: Reproducibility and compass offset is always 0 or pi:

h0 = train_prestructured(loadPrestructuredAgent(seed=1, learn=False, thetaG0=pi), env, Ttot=3.0)
h1 = train_prestructured(loadPrestructuredAgent(seed=1, learn=False, thetaG0=pi), env, Ttot=3.0)
test_close(h0.t, h1.t)
test_close(h0.thetaA, h1.thetaA)
h2 = train_prestructured(loadPrestructuredAgent(seed=2, learn=False, thetaG0=pi), env, Ttot=3.0)
assert len(h2.t) != len(h0.t) or not np.allclose(h2.thetaA, h0.thetaA)
off = np.abs(angdiff(h0.thetaC, h0.thetaA))
assert np.all(np.isclose(off, 0.0) | np.isclose(off, pi))

relHeading and readout on a hand-built history:

test_close(relHeading(np.array([pi, pi + 0.1]), pi)[1], np.rad2deg(0.1))
hand = EventHistory(
    t=np.array([0.0, 1.0]),
    thetaA=np.array([pi, 0.0]),
    thetaC=np.array([pi, pi]),
    fixDur=np.array([0.5, 1.5]),
    direction=np.array([1, -1], dtype=np.int64),
    jumped=np.array([False, True]),
    reward=np.array([0.1, -0.1]),
    thetaG=np.array([pi, pi]),
)
ro = readout(hand, pi, nBins=2)
test_eq(ro['count'].sum(), 2)
test_close(ro['fixDur'][1], 0.5)   # rel = 0 at the goal
test_close(ro['turnBias'][1], 1.0)
test_close(ro['fixDur'][0], 1.5)   # rel = -180 at the anti-goal
test_close(ro['turnBias'][0], -1.0)


ro4 = readout(hand, pi, nBins=4)
test_eq(ro4['count'].tolist(), [1, 0, 1, 0])
assert np.isnan(ro4['fixDur'][1]) and np.isnan(ro4['turnBias'][3])
test_close(relHeading(0.0, pi), -180.0)
assert np.all(relHeading(np.linspace(0, 2 * pi, 50), 1.0) < 180)


# hand history: updates land at 0 + 0.5 + tS and 1 + 1.5 + tS
tS = 0.32
test_close(heldGoal(hand, 2.0, [0.0, 0.81, 2.81, 100.0], tS), [2.0, 2.0, pi, pi])
hand2 = EventHistory(**{**hand.__dict__, 'thetaG': np.array([1.0, 3.0])})
test_close(heldGoal(hand2, 2.0, [0.5, 0.83, 2.81, 2.83], tS), [2.0, 1.0, 1.0, 3.0])


runs = runManyPrestructured(params=p, goal=pi, nRuns=2, seed=10, Ttot=30.0, learn=False, thetaG0=pi)
test_eq(len(runs), 2)
for d in runs:
    test_eq(set(d.keys()), {'history', 'readout', 'thetaG0', 'jumpRate'})
    test_close(d['thetaG0'], pi)

title: explRL
text: This package builds brain-inspired AI agents that simultaneously explore novel environments and map their value landscapes. It integrates autonomous navigation, unsupervised environment mapping and reinforcement learning coupled with internal drives. The starting code is ported and modified from MATLAB scripts (Ann M. Hermundstad) described in this publication: A neural circuit architecture for rapid learning in goal-directed navigation. Chuntao Dan, Brad K. Hulse, Ramya Kappagantula, Vivek Jayaraman, Ann M. Hermundstad. https://doi.org/10.1016/j.neuron.2024.04.036. (open access)

The end-to-end reproduction is in nbs/demo.ipynb. Step-by-step instructions: specs/demo/RUN.md.
Install dev dependencies, then run from the repo root:
pip install -e ".[dev]"

Circuit model (Figs 3-5): nbs/demo_circuit.ipynb and specs/circuit/RUN.md.

title: explRL
text:
How to use
This package is in early development (alpha). It implements three variants from the paper: the flexible policy (explRL.basis, flexibleAgent, policy-gradient RL), the pre-structured setpoint policy with bump jumps (explRL.prestructured), and the circuit model with Hebbian compass and goal weights (explRL.circuit). Shared pieces: explRL.params, explRL.envs (heading and zone arenas), explRL.train, and explRL.core loaders.
For the full Fig 2d-e reproduction, see Running the demo above.
Example (build an agent and arena, then train briefly):

from math import pi
from explRL.core import loadAgent, loadEnv
from explRL.train import train_agent, evaluatePolicy

agent = loadAgent(goal=pi, seed=0)
env = loadEnv(goal=pi)
hist = train_agent(agent, env, Ttot=2.0)   # the paper uses 240 s
policy = evaluatePolicy(agent)            # drift rate, fixation duration and turn bias per heading

from math import pi
from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_close
from explRL.params import Params
from explRL.core import loadCircuitAgent
from explRL.envs import ZoneArena

p = Params()
N = p.nCirc
env = ZoneArena()
quiet = dict(learnC=False, learnG=False, jumps=False)
hist = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(params=p, seed=0, **quiet), env, Ttot=5.0)
n = len(hist.t)
assert n > 0
for f in fields(CircuitHistory):
    test_eq(len(getattr(hist, f.name)), n)
assert hist.t[-1] < 5.0 <= endTime(hist, p.tS)
assert np.all(np.diff(hist.t) > 0)
h2 = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(params=p, seed=0, **quiet), env, Ttot=5.0, t0=100.0)
test_close(h2.t[0], 100.0)
assert h2.t[-1] < 105.0 <= endTime(h2, p.tS)
both = concatHistory([hist, h2])
test_eq(len(both.t), n + len(h2.t))
test_eq(len(train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(seed=0), env, Ttot=0.0).t), 0)

AC-7: one seed gives one history; the mirror sum only changes by N/2, and only on jumps.

h0 = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(seed=1, **quiet), env, Ttot=30.0)
h1 = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(seed=1, **quiet), env, Ttot=30.0)
test_close(h0.t, h1.t); test_eq(h0.a, h1.a)
h3 = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(seed=2, **quiet), env, Ttot=30.0)
assert len(h3.t) != len(h0.t) or not np.allclose(h0.a, h3.a)
assert np.all(h0.mirror == h0.mirror[0])
hj = train_circuit(loadCircuitAgent(seed=5, learnC=False, learnG=False, jumps=True), env, Ttot=60.0)
assert hj.jumped.any()
d = np.diff(hj.mirror) % N
assert np.all((d == 0) | (d == N // 2))
assert np.all((d == N // 2) == hj.jumped[1:])

Measures on a hand-built history:

hand = CircuitHistory(
    t=np.array([0.0, 1.0, 2.0]), a=np.array([8, 8, 24]), c=np.array([0, 0, 0]),
    direction=np.array([1, -1, 1]), steps=np.array([1, 1, 1]), jumped=np.array([False, False, False]),
    valence=np.array([1, -1, 1]), fixDur=np.array([0.5, 1.0, 0.5]),
    thetaG=np.array([0.0, 0.0, 0.0]), strength=np.array([0.3, 0.4, 0.5]), mirror=np.array([8, 8, 24]))
test_close(heldValue(hand, hand.strength, 0.2, [0.0, 0.9, 2.5], p.tS), [0.2, 0.3, 0.4])
test_close(piScore(hand), (0.5 - 1.0 + 0.5) / 2.0)
test_close(goalArena(hand, N), [pi / 2, pi / 2, -pi / 2])
test_close(goalSafeDistance(hand, env), [0.0, 0.0, 0.0])
ro = readout(hand, N)
test_eq(ro['count'].sum(), 3)
k = int(np.flatnonzero(ro['count'])[0])        # all three sit at their goal (relative heading 0)
test_eq(ro['count'][k], 3)
test_close(ro['fixDur'][k], 2.0 / 3)
test_close(ro['turnBias'][k], (-1 + 1) / 2)    # next saccades of iterations 0 and 1

pJ along a map, the most stable compass heading, and probes:

za, zs = ZoneArena(symmetric=False), ZoneArena(symmetric=True)
wC = np.zeros((N, N)); wC[0, 0] = 1.0
mjp = mapJumpProb(wC, za, mirror=0)
test_eq(len(mjp), N)
test_close(mjp[0], jumpProb(wC, za.ringActivity(0), 0))
pja = mapJumpProb(np.random.default_rng(0).uniform(0, 1, (N, N)), zs, 3)
test_close(pja[:N // 2] + pja[N // 2:], np.ones(N // 2))

wS = np.ones((N, N)); wS[:, 27] = 0.0            # compass 27 (arena 5 on map 0) never jumps
test_close(stablestCompass(wS, za, 0), grid(N)[27])

agp = loadCircuitAgent(seed=9)
wG0, wC0, st = agp.policy.wG.copy(), agp.policy.wC.copy(), agp.rng.bit_generator.state
pr = probe(agp, env, T=20.0, seed=99)
test_eq(set(pr), {'history', 'PI', 'jumpRate'})
test_close(agp.policy.wG, wG0); test_close(agp.policy.wC, wC0)
test_eq(agp.rng.bit_generator.state, st)
assert agp.rl.learnC and agp.rl.learnG
test_close(pr['jumpRate'], pr['history'].jumped.mean())

PolicyGradientRL
def PolicyGradientRL(
    policy, lr:float=1.0, eps:float=1e-12
):
Online policy-gradient learning for flexibleAgent (paper Eqs. 13-18, Algorithm 1).


Tests use a small agent with a flat basis so results are easy to predict:

from fastcore.test import test_eq, test_fail, test_close
from explRL.params import Params

def toy_agent(theta=0.0, aF=10.0, nb=4, nx=8, omega=None, seed=None):
    "Builds a small flexibleAgent for testing."
    policy = flexiblePolicy(omega=np.zeros(2 * nb) if omega is None else omega,
                            fk=np.ones((nb, nx)), wParams=np.array([0.5, 1.0, 0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 0.0]))
    params = Params(nx=nx, nb=nb, delT=0.01, sigF=0.1, aF=aF, muS=0.0, sigmaS=0.5, tS=0.05)
    return flexibleAgent(theta, None, policy, PolicyGradientRL(policy), params, rng=np.random.default_rng(seed))

agent = toy_agent()
nu, pR = agent.convertParams(agent.policy.omega, agent.policy.fk[:, 0], agent.policy.wParams)
test_eq((nu, pR), (0.5, 0.5))   # all-zero weights give sigmoid(0) = fmax/2

With a high threshold the agent fixates; with a tiny threshold it saccades, the step lasts dtS and the integrator resets:

agent = toy_agent(aF=10.0, seed=1)
step = agent.samplePolicy()
test_eq((step.saccade, step.dx, step.dt, step.direction), (False, 0.0, 1, 0))
test_eq(step.ind, agent._heading_index(8))
test_close(agent.policy.integ, step.xi + step.dxi)

agent = toy_agent(aF=1e-6, seed=2)
step = agent.samplePolicy()
assert step.saccade and step.direction in (1, -1)
test_eq(step.dt, agent.params.dtS)
test_eq(agent.policy.integ, 0.0)
assert isinstance(step.dx, float) and step.dx != round(step.dx)   # radians, not rounded
assert np.sign(step.dx) == step.direction

Headings are stored wrapped into [0, 2π), and the nearest basis column wraps too:

test_close(toy_agent(theta=-0.1).theta, 2 * np.pi - 0.1)
test_eq(toy_agent(theta=2 * np.pi - 0.01)._heading_index(8), 0)
test_eq(toy_agent(theta=np.pi)._heading_index(8), 4)
test_eq(toy_agent(theta=7 * np.pi)._heading_index(8), 4)

The same seed gives the same sequence of steps:

a0, a1 = toy_agent(aF=0.05, seed=99), toy_agent(aF=0.05, seed=99)
for _ in range(20):
    test_eq(a0.samplePolicy(), a1.samplePolicy())

sigmoidGrad and gradLogPi match finite differences, for a fixation and for clockwise and counter-clockwise saccades (AC-2):

ag = toy_agent(omega=np.linspace(-0.3, 0.3, 8))
x = 0.3
test_close(ag.sigmoidGrad(x, 1.0, 1.0), (ag.sigmoid(x + 1e-5, 1, 1, 0) - ag.sigmoid(x - 1e-5, 1, 1, 0)) / 2e-5, eps=1e-6)

def fd_check(step, h=1e-6):
    rl, om = ag.rl, ag.policy.omega.copy()
    g = rl.gradLogPi(ag, step)
    fd = np.array([(rl.logPi(ag, step, om + h * e) - rl.logPi(ag, step, om - h * e)) / (2 * h) for e in np.eye(om.size)])
    assert np.max(np.abs(g - fd)) <= 1e-4 * max(1.0, np.max(np.abs(fd))), (g, fd)

xi = ag.params.aF - 0.02   # near the threshold, so fixation and saccade are both plausible
fd_check(Step(0.0, 0, xi, 0.0, False, 0, 0.0, 1))
fd_check(Step(0.0, 0, xi, 0.0, True, 1, 0.5, ag.params.dtS))
fd_check(Step(0.0, 0, xi, 0.0, True, -1, -0.5, ag.params.dtS))

Gradients stay finite when the fixation probability is very close to 0 or 1 (NFR-7):

for xi in (-50.0, 50.0):
    for sac, d in ((False, 0), (True, 1), (True, -1)):
        assert np.isfinite(ag.rl.gradLogPi(ag, Step(0.0, 0, xi, 0.0, sac, d, 0.0, 1))).all()

A positive reward after a clockwise saccade raises pR at that heading, a negative reward lowers it, and zero reward changes nothing (AC-3):

def pR_after(reward):
    a = toy_agent()
    step = Step(0.0, 0, 0.0, 0.0, True, 1, 0.5, a.params.dtS)
    a.rl.updateParams(a, step, reward)
    return a.convertParams(a.policy.omega, a.policy.fk[:, 0], a.policy.wParams)[1], a.policy.omega

p_pos, _ = pR_after(1.0)
p_neg, _ = pR_after(-1.0)
assert p_pos > 0.5 > p_neg
_, om0 = pR_after(0.0)
test_eq(om0, np.zeros(8))

Bad inputs fail early, and the base RL class still has to be subclassed:

test_fail(lambda: toy_agent(omega=np.zeros(7)), contains="even length")

Three conditions: fixed goal with jumps (Fig 2h), goal learning without jumps, and goal learning with jumps. The quick cell keeps normal tests fast; the slow cell reruns with 20 runs.

runs_fix = runManyPrestructured(params, goal, nRuns, seed=seed, learn=False, thetaG0=goal)

def pooled(runs):
    "Fixation durations and relative headings (degrees) of all events of all runs."
    fix = np.concatenate([r['history'].fixDur for r in runs])
    rel = np.concatenate([relHeading(r['history'].thetaA, goal) for r in runs])
    return fix, rel

def distGoal(g): return np.abs(angdiff(g, goal))
def distNearer(g): return np.minimum(distGoal(g), np.abs(angdiff(g, goal + pi)))

grid = np.arange(0, params.Ttot, 1.0)
lastQ = grid >= 0.75 * params.Ttot

def distTrace(r, dist):
    "Distance of the goal heading in effect at each grid time (1 s steps)."
    return dist(heldGoal(r['history'], r['thetaG0'], grid, params.tS))

def startAndLastQuarter(runs, dist):
    "Distance at the start and time-averaged over the last quarter of the run, averaged over runs."
    start = np.mean([dist(r['thetaG0']) for r in runs])
    last = np.mean([distTrace(r, dist)[lastQ].mean() for r in runs])
    return float(start), float(last)

fix, rel = pooled(runs_fix)
near = float(fix[np.abs(rel) <= 30].mean())
anti = float(fix[np.abs(rel) >= 150].mean())
side = float(fix[(np.abs(rel) >= 60) & (np.abs(rel) <= 120)].mean())
ac9 = startAndLastQuarter(runs_learn, distGoal)
ac10 = startAndLastQuarter(runs_jump, distNearer)

title: demo_prestructured
text:
Summary
With the paper’s Table 1 setpoint parameters, the decided signs (spec Q1, Q2) and no tuning, 20 runs of 240 s (seeds 0-19) gave:

AC-8: mean fixation 11.5 s within ±30 degrees of the goal and 10.6 s within ±30 degrees of the anti-goal, versus 2.5 s at 60-120 degrees from the goal: the readout is bimodal, as in Fig 2h.
AC-9: without jumps, the distance from the goal heading to the reward goal fell from 1.67 rad at the start to 0.51 rad (time average over the last quarter).
AC-10 (reported only): with jumps, the distance to the nearer of goal / anti-goal went from 0.84 to 0.74 rad, so no clear convergence.

The simulated anti-goal peak is much higher than Eq. 23 predicts (3.2 s), because the compass offset persists between jumps. All three conditions run in about a second.
